about: Backfill only. Posts made before legacy_credit_line_until by these logins count as peeryard reviews when they open with a credit line (Review carried out by / Prepared with ...) but carry neither the <!-- peeryard {...} --> marker nor the words 'using peeryard': reviews posted from a sibling toolchain whose credit line had dropped the phrase. After that date only the marker or the phrase counts, whoever posts; this list does not grow.
